name: tps25751-bench
description: Verify the TPS25751 library's register decode against USB PD traffic captured by a KM003C meter: the tps25751-pd-verify skill and the pd-capture-analyst agent. Uses the km003c, tps25751-bench, and usb-pd-docs MCP servers, which the project configures. Until Phase 8 of the toolset plan the library configures neither the plugin nor the km003c and tps25751-bench servers; load them for one session with claude --mcp-config <file> --plugin-dir plugins/tps25751-bench.
